proposals.evidence: The unaspirated loṭ-/luṭ- lie-down verb matches Turner *lōrtati, including Pk loṭṭai rolls/sleeps and luṭṭai sleeps. These are a simple past or imperative/past pair of the same verb; no independent go auxiliary is present.
